findings.evidence: V003 defines hhy.ticket_messages.sender_id as nullable, and V048 only makes sender_type/body NOT NULL while the idempotency unique index is (ticket_id, sender_type, sender_id, idempotency_key). In PostgreSQL, NULL values are distinct in a normal UNIQUE index, so two SYSTEM/ADMIN messages on the same ticket with sender_id NULL and the same idempotency_key/request_hash pass the check constraint and bypass message idempotency. The new test only covers a duplicate with non-null sender_id.
findings.issue: ticket_messages idempotency is not enforced for nullable sender_id, violating the TASK-R15-002 acceptance that message idempotency identity is immutable.
findings.requirement_ref: TASK-R15-002 acceptance: 消息幂等身份不可变
